versions.title: Analytical Support Retainer
versions.subtitle: Twelve months of method support for the Graz laboratory

legal.intro: This offer sets out a twelve-month retainer for method support at ACME Labs GmbH. It is still a draft and has not been issued.
legal.accept_text: ACME Labs GmbH accepts this retainer by signing below. Work starts on the first day of the agreed quarter.
legal.vat_note: Amounts are net. Value added tax is shown with the totals.
legal.discount_note: No discount is deducted from the positions. This note is shown with the totals.
legal.payment_terms: The retainer is billed quarterly in advance and is payable within 14 days of the invoice.

nodes.text: The retainer covers planned method reviews, a monthly office hour and a written note after each visit. It does not include instrument repair or a standby service outside office hours.
One on-site method review each quarter, prepared with the laboratory lead.
A short written note of findings, stored with the quote file.

positions.long_text: Preparation, one day on site in Graz, and the written note.
A scheduled call with purchasing and the laboratory lead.
Scheduling, the quarterly invoice and the file of visit notes.
